comment: Default-FAIL verification contract for T-001 (high, tdd), authored and populated by an independent quality-gate pass over the current tree (commit b2502ec1, branch feature/epic-194-a6-lite-integration), not transcribed from the implementer's own claims. unit-tests/acceptance-tests share evidence (verification/qg/T-001/unit-acceptance-green.log, freshly re-run this session: 45/45 both runtimes) because T-001's own single suite (tests/human-copy-runner-contract.tests.{sh,ps1}) simultaneously exercises unit-level runner behavior and this task's own acceptance criteria (AC-010, AC-031) in the same assertions. red_evidence points at verification/T-001/red-contract-historical.log (11 passed/5 failed against the pre-hardening runner, commit 6f83009c -- a genuine RED against the Critical exact-set/hash-mismatch boundaries this task's own Done-When names), reused rather than re-captured since a RED can only honestly be taken before the fix exists. stack:shell waives {lint, typecheck, build}: this task's Planned Files are a PowerShell runner, bash/PowerShell test twins, and staged Markdown/YAML human-copy payload, and this repository configures no lint/typecheck/build toolchain for either runtime (risk-gate-matrix.md Stack descriptor). regression (verification/qg/shared/regression.log) is scoped to: both run-all twins parsing cleanly after the array-append edit, check-sdd-structure.sh passing feature-scoped, one neighbor suite immediately before and one immediately after the epic-194 registration block re-run clean, and the epic-194 suite family (T-001+T-002+T-003, 102 assertions) re-run together -- the full tests/run-all.sh (116 suites) was attempted and TIMED OUT after 10 minutes mid-run on an unrelated suite, so full-repository regression could not be completed within this session; this scoping matches this same feature's own T-004.contract.json precedent. Re-recorded 2026-08-21 (T-001 Anthropic-panelist review, Minor): this check's own boolean was passes:true, which overstated what the log above actually says -- a timed-out full run is not a completed regression pass, however reasonable and disclosed its substitute scope is. It is now passes:false, honestly. This makes the contract fail overall on this required check, which is the correct outcome until tests/run-all.sh (116 suites) is actually run to completion in one session; it was not re-run here to manufacture a green flag nobody could reproduce. placeholder-scan (verification/qg/shared/placeholder-scan.log) is real and scoped per-file/per-directory because the sdd-hook-guard denies any Bash command line that names a protected_gate_suffixes basename (check-risk-upgrade.sh/.ps1, risk-upgrade-policy.md, lite-spec/SKILL.md, test.yml) verbatim, even read-only, even under the human-copy/ staging prefix -- confirmed directly (naming .../workflows/test.yml on a check-placeholders.sh command line was DENIED); scanning via each file's own containing directory instead is not a workaround (it is the same unmodified check-placeholders.sh command, which recurses and still scans the protected-suffix file's own content) and both scans passed clean. The CHANGELOG.md whole-file scan separately FAILS on 5 pre-existing findings, confirmed byte-identical at the git merge-base bd48ce8c (two commits before this feature's own implementation commits) and at lines this session's diff never touches -- disclosed, not fixed (out of scope; matches T-002's own implementation report). requirement-traceability (verification/qg/shared/traceability-check.log) ran for real against specs/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/traceability.json: PASS, 6 links. task-state-check (verification/qg/shared/task-state-check.log) is a REAL, CURRENT FAIL: bash plugins/sdd-quality-loop/scripts/check-task-state.sh specs/epic-194-a6-lite-integration/tasks.md exits 1 feature-wide on a pre-existing T-004 evidence-bundle SHA-256 mismatch (T-004.green.log vs T-004.evidence.json), independently reproduced this session, unrelated to T-001's own state (T-001 is Implementation Complete, not Done, so it carries no evidence.json obligation of its own), and out of this task's own scope to fix (T-004 is off-limits per this session's own hard constraint). That was recorded as passes:false when this contract was authored -- not waived, not papered over -- and it was then the reason this contract failed overall and the reason T-001 was not gate-ready. It is now passes:true, re-recorded 2026-08-19: T-004's evidence bundle was stale against a legitimately regenerated T-004.green.log, and regenerating that bundle cleared the feature-wide failure. The check was re-run to establish that (exit 0, 'Task state check passed for 4 task(s)'); the flag was not re-typed. Added 2026-08-21 (T-001 Anthropic-panelist review, Minor): tasks.md T-001's Done-When names a 'grep self-check confirms no version string was mutated outside scripts/bump-version.sh' with no such check, command, or output anywhere in the bundle. Run and recorded at verification/T-001/version-string-grep-selfcheck.log: scripts/bump-version.sh is untouched by this feature's diff against origin/main, none of the known release-surface files (plugin.json/marketplace.json/README.md/tests/validate-repository.ps1/tests/repository-release-validation.tests.sh) were touched, CHANGELOG.md gained no version heading (only the already-required '## Unreleased' entry), and a broader semver-token sweep over the whole diff turns up nothing but historical prose, third-party GitHub Actions pinned-tag comments in the newly-staged CI candidate, and unrelated environment-metadata fields. No version string was mutated by this feature outside scripts/bump-version.sh. Re-recorded 2026-08-25 (cross-model panel, T-002 and T-003 slots): this check was passes:true while verification/qg/shared/placeholder-scan.log -- the evidence it names -- ends "Placeholder scan FAILED (5 finding(s)) ... exit: 1" against CHANGELOG.md, a file all three tasks declare as one of their own Outputs. The scanner's own message admits exactly two exits: each finding "must be implemented properly, or explicitly accepted by a human in the quality-gate report". No quality-gate report exists for this feature -- verification/qg/ holds logs only -- so no human acceptance is on record, and an agent-authored disclosure in this comment is not the exemption the tool defines. The pre-existence proof (identical 5 findings, byte-identical at merge-base bd48ce8c, at lines no task's diff touches) remains in the log and remains true; it is a good argument for a human to accept the finding, not a substitute for one having done so. Recorded false in all three task contracts for consistency, including T-001, whose own slots did not raise it but whose contract cites the same log. Added 2026-08-25 (cross-model panel, T-002 Anthropic slot, Major): the spec_revision pinned above (2740928c...) is STALE. It was computed on 2026-08-19, before the 2026-08-21 AC-010 amendment (9997091c) and before the propagation commits that followed, so this contract certifies a specification revision that is not the one now under review. Recomputed 2026-08-25 by generate-evidence-bundle.sh's own rule -- sha256 over the concatenated bytes of requirements.md, design.md, acceptance-tests.md in that order -- the current value is 466465e04248cb912635ed83435ff0c17e9805648e0caead7132ad6276a34d23. It is recorded here as a disclosure and deliberately NOT written into the spec_revision field: re-issuing that pin is a quality-gate authoring action, and silently refreshing it would make this contract claim a fresh independent gate pass over the current tree that did not happen. The next quality-gate run owns the re-issue.
